
### def create_product( 18623
def create_product(c,p,uid):
    sku=textv(p,'sku',60,True);name=textv(p,'name',140,True)
    packages=p.get('packages',[])
    if not isinstance(packages,list) or not packages:raise ValueError('أدخل وحدة تعبئة واحدة على الأقل مع باركودها أو رمزها الداخلي')
    checked=[]
    for pk in packages:
        factor=posint(pk.get('factor'),'معامل التحويل')
        unit=textv(pk,'unit_name',40,True)
        barcode=textv(pk,'barcode',80)
        price=amt(pk.get('sale_price',0),'سعر البيع')
        checked.append((unit,factor,barcode or None,price,int(bool(pk.get('is_default',0)))))
    if sum(x[4] for x in checked)!=1:raise ValueError('يجب اختيار وحدة بيع افتراضية واحدة')
    begin(c)
    try:
        row=c.execute('INSERT INTO products(sku,name,generic_name,strength,form,manufacturer,base_uom,rx_required,reorder_point,created_at) VALUES(?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?)',(sku,name,textv(p,'generic_name'),textv(p,'strength'),textv(p,'form'),textv(p,'manufacturer'),textv(p,'base_uom',30) or 'حبة',int(bool(p.get('rx_required',0))),amt(p.get('reorder_point',0)),now()))
        pid=row.lastrowid
        for unit,factor,barcode,price,default in checked:c.execute('INSERT INTO packages(product_id,unit_name,factor,barcode,sale_price,is_default) VALUES(?,?,?,?,?,?)',(pid,unit,factor,barcode,price,default))
        audit(c,uid,'create_product',{'id':pid,'sku':sku})
        finish(c)
    except:rollback(c);raise
    return {'id':pid}

def update_product(c,p,uid):
    pid=posint(p.get('product_id'),'الصنف')
    begin(c)
    try:
        existing=one(c,'SELECT * FROM products WHERE id=?',(pid,))
        if not existing:raise ValueError('الصنف غير موجود')
        editable={'name':140,'generic_name':160,'strength':80,'form':80,'manufacturer':160}
        vals={k:textv(p,k,limit,required=k=='name') if k in p else existing[k] for k,limit in editable.items()}
        active=int(bool(p.get('active',existing['active'])))
        rx=int(bool(p.get('rx_required',existing['rx_required'])))
        reorder=amt(p.get('reorder_point',existing['reorder_point']),'حد إعادة الطلب')
        c.execute('UPDATE products SET name=?,generic_name=?,strength=?,form=?,manufacturer=?,active=?,rx_required=?,reorder_point=? WHERE id=?',(vals['name'],vals['generic_name'],vals['strength'],vals['form'],vals['manufacturer'],active,rx,reorder,pid))
        audit(c,uid,'edit_product',{'id':pid,'old':{k:existing[k] for k in ['name','active','rx_required','reorder_point']},'new':{'name':vals['name'],'active':active,'rx_required':rx,'reorder_point':reorder}})
        finish(c)
    except:rollback(c);raise
    return {'id':pid,'updated':True}

def edit_package(c,p,uid):
    id=posint(p.get('package_id'),'معرف العبوة');row=one(c,'SELECT * FROM packages WHERE id=?',(id,))
    if not row:raise ValueError('العبوة غير موجودة')
    barcode=textv(p,'barcode',80)
    price=amt(p.get('sale_price',row['sale_price']),'سعر البيع')
    begin(c)
    try:
        # Packaging factor cannot change after stock history; requires separate migration workflow
        c.execute('UPDATE packages SET barcode=?,sale_price=? WHERE id=?',(barcode or None,price,id))
        audit(c,uid,'update_package',{'id':id,'barcode_before':row['barcode'],'barcode_after':barcode,'old_price':row['sale_price'],'new_price':price})
        finish(c)
    except:rollback(c);raise
    return {'id':id}

def create_party(c,p,kind,uid):
    name=textv(p,'name',160,True)
    begin(c)
    try:
        cur=c.execute(('INSERT INTO suppliers(name,phone,notes) VALUES(?,?,?)' if kind=='supplier' else 'INSERT INTO partners(name,kind,phone,parent_id) VALUES(?,?,?,?)'),((name,textv(p,'phone',35),textv(p,'notes',300)) if kind=='supplier' else (name,kind,textv(p,'phone',35),p.get('parent_id'))))
        audit(c,uid,'create_'+kind,{'id':cur.lastrowid,'name':name})
        finish(c)
    except:rollback(c);raise
    return {'id':cur.lastrowid}

def available_lots(c,pid):
    return query(c,'SELECT * FROM lots WHERE product_id=? AND status=? AND qty_base>0 AND (expiry=? OR expiry>=?) ORDER BY CASE WHEN expiry=? THEN 1 ELSE 0 END,expiry,id',(pid,'sellable','',today(),''))

def allocate(c,pid,qty,slid,uid,doc):
    needed=qty;total_cost=0
    for lot in available_lots(c,pid):
        take=min(needed,lot['qty_base'])
        if take<=0:continue
        c.execute('UPDATE lots SET qty_base=qty_base-? WHERE id=? AND qty_base>=?',(take,lot['id'],take))
        if c.execute('SELECT changes()').fetchone()[0]!=1:raise ValueError('تعذر حسم الرصيد، حاول مرة أخرى')
        cost=(take*lot['unit_cost_milli']+500)//1000
        c.execute('INSERT INTO sale_allocations(sale_line_id,lot_id,qty_base,cost) VALUES(?,?,?,?)',(slid,lot['id'],take,cost))
        c.execute('INSERT INTO stock_moves(product_id,lot_id,qty_base,kind,document,created_at,user_id) VALUES(?,?,?,?,?,?,?)',(pid,lot['id'],-take,'sale',doc,now(),uid))
        total_cost+=cost;needed-=take
        if needed==0:break
    if needed:raise ValueError('الرصيد المتاح غير كافٍ: '+one(c,'SELECT name FROM products WHERE id=?',(pid,))['name'])
    return total_cost

def purchase(c,p,uid):
    supplier=posint(p.get('supplier_id'),'المورد')
    if not one(c,'SELECT id FROM suppliers WHERE id=?',(supplier,)):raise ValueError('المورد غير موجود')
    ref=textv(p,'invoice_ref',100) or ('LOCAL-'+datetime.now().strftime('%Y%m%d')+'-'+uuid.uuid4().hex[:12].upper()); dt=textv(p,'invoice_date',20) or today(); date.fromisoformat(dt)
    if one(c,'SELECT period FROM closed_periods WHERE period=?',(dt[:7],)):
        raise ValueError('لا يمكن إنشاء فاتورة بتاريخ فترة مقفلة')
    rows=p.get('items')
    if not isinstance(rows,list) or not rows:raise ValueError('أضف صنفاً واحداً على الأقل')
    checked=[]
    for x in rows:
        pk=one(c,'SELECT packages.*,products.name FROM packages JOIN products ON products.id=packages.product_id WHERE packages.id=?',(posint(x.get('package_id'),'العبوة'),))
        if not pk:raise ValueError('صنف الفاتورة غير موجود')
        qty=posint(x.get('qty'),'كمية الفاتورة');received=amt(x.get('received',qty),'المستلم');bonus=amt(x.get('bonus',0),'البونص')
        if received>qty:raise ValueError('المستلم لا يمكن أن يتجاوز كمية الفاتورة')
        cost=amt(x.get('unit_cost'),'سعر الشراء');batch=textv(x,'batch',70); expiry=textv(x,'expiry',10)
        if received+bonus and not re.fullmatch(r'\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}',expiry):raise ValueError('الصلاحية يجب أن تكون YYYY-MM-DD')
        if expiry:
            try:expiry_date=date.fromisoformat(expiry)
            except ValueError:raise ValueError('تاريخ الصلاحية غير صحيح')
            if received+bonus and expiry_date<=date.today():raise ValueError('الصلاحية اليوم أو منتهية؛ لا يمكن إضافة كمية متاحة للبيع')
        discount=amt(x.get('discount',0),'خصم السطر');line=qty*cost-discount
        if line<0:raise ValueError('خصم أكبر من قيمة السطر')
        checked.append((pk,qty,received,bonus,cost,batch,expiry,line))
    total=sum(x[-1] for x in checked);paid=amt(p.get('paid',0),'المدفوع');method=textv(p,'payment_method',24) or 'credit'
    if paid>total or method not in ('cash','bank','credit'):raise ValueError('سداد غير صالح')
    if method=='credit' and paid:raise ValueError('اختر كاش أو تحويل للسداد الجزئي')
    bankref=textv(p,'bank_ref',90)
    if paid and method=='bank' and not bankref:raise ValueError('أدخل مرجع التحويل')
    begin(c)
    try:
        new=c.execute('INSERT INTO purchases(supplier_id,invoice_ref,invoice_date,created_at,user_id,total,paid,payment_method,bank_ref,note) VALUES(?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?)',(supplier,ref,dt,now(),uid,total,paid,method,bankref,textv(p,'note',500))).lastrowid
       

### def edit_package( 21244

    if not row:raise ValueError('العبوة غير موجودة')
    barcode=textv(p,'barcode',80)
    price=amt(p.get('sale_price',row['sale_price']),'سعر البيع')
    begin(c)
    try:
        # Packaging factor cannot change after stock history; requires separate migration workflow
        c.execute('UPDATE packages SET barcode=?,sale_price=? WHERE id=?',(barcode or None,price,id))
        audit(c,uid,'update_package',{'id':id,'barcode_before':row['barcode'],'barcode_after':barcode,'old_price':row['sale_price'],'new_price':price})
        finish(c)
    except:rollback(c);raise
    return {'id':id}

def allocate(c,pid,qty,slid,uid,doc):

    for lot in available_lots(c,pid):
        take=min(needed,lot['qty_base'])

        c.execute('UPDATE lots SET qty_base=qty_base-? WHERE id=? AND qty_base>=?',(take,lot['id'],take))
        if c.execute('SELECT changes()').fetchone()[0]!=1:raise ValueError('تعذر حسم الرصيد، حاول مرة أخرى')
        cost=(take*lot['unit_cost_milli']+500)//1000
        c.execute('INSERT INTO sale_allocations(sale_line_id,lot_id,qty_base,cost) VALUES(?,?,?,?)',(slid,lot['id'],take,cost))
        c.execute('INSERT INTO stock_moves(product_id,lot_id,qty_base,kind,document,created_at,user_id) VALUES(?,?,?,?,?,?,?)',(pid,lot['id'],-take,'sale',doc,now(),uid))
        total_cost+=cost;needed-=take
        if needed==0:break
    if needed:raise ValueError('الرصيد المتاح غير كافٍ: '+one(c,'SELECT name FROM products WHERE id=?',(pid,))['name'])
    return total_cost

def purchase(c,p,uid):
    supplier=posint(p.get('supplier_id'),'المورد')
    if not one(c,'SELECT id FROM suppliers WHERE id=?',(supplier,)):raise ValueError('المورد غير موجود')
    ref=textv(p,'invoice_ref',100) or ('LOCAL-'+datetime.now().strftime('%Y%m%d')+'-'+uuid.uuid4().hex[:12].upper()); dt=textv(p,'invoice_date',20) or today(); date.fromisoformat(dt)
    if one(c,'SELECT period FROM closed_periods WHERE period=?',(dt[:7],)):
        raise ValueError('لا يمكن إنشاء فاتورة بتاريخ فترة مقفلة')
    rows=p.get('items')
    if not isinstance(rows,list) or not rows:raise ValueError('أضف صنفاً واحداً على الأقل')
    checked=[]
    for x in rows:
        pk=one(c,'SELECT packages.*,products.name FROM packages JOIN products ON products.id=packages.product_id WHERE packages.id=?',(posint(x.get('package_id'),'العبوة'),))
        if not pk:raise ValueError('صنف الفاتورة غير موجود')
        qty=posint(x.get('qty'),'كمية الفاتورة');received=amt(x.get('received',qty),'المستلم');bonus=amt(x.get('bonus',0),'البونص')
        if received>qty:raise ValueError('المستلم لا يمكن أن يتجاوز كمية الفاتورة')
        cost=amt(x.get('unit_cost'),'سعر الشراء');batch=textv(x,'batch',70); expiry=textv(x,'expiry',10)
        if received+bonus and not re.fullmatch(r'\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}',expiry):raise ValueError('الصلاحية يجب أن تكون YYYY-MM-DD')
        if expiry:
            try:expiry_date=date.fromisoformat(expiry)
            except ValueError:raise ValueError('تاريخ الصلاحية غير صحيح')
            if received+bonus and expiry_date<=date.today():raise ValueError('الصلاحية اليوم أو منتهية؛ لا يمكن إضافة كمية متاحة للبيع')
        discount=amt(x.get('discount',0),'خصم السطر');line=qty*cost-discount
        if line<0:raise ValueError('خصم أكبر من قيمة السطر')
        checked.append((pk,qty,received,bonus,cost,batch,expiry,line))
    total=sum(x[-1] for x in checked);paid=amt(p.get('paid',0),'المدفوع');method=textv(p,'payment_method',24) or 'credit'
    if paid>total or method not in ('cash','bank','credit'):raise ValueError('سداد غير صالح')
    if method=='credit' and paid:raise ValueError('اختر كاش أو تحويل للسداد الجزئي')
    bankref=textv(p,'bank_ref',90)
    if paid and method=='bank' and not bankref:raise ValueError('أدخل مرجع التحويل')
    begin(c)
    try:
        new=c.execute('INSERT INTO purchases(supplier_id,invoice_ref,invoice_date,created_at,user_id,total,paid,payment_method,bank_ref,note) VALUES(?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?)',(supplier,ref,dt,now(),uid,total,paid,method,bankref,textv(p,'note',500))).lastrowid
        asset=0
        for pk,qty,received,bonus,cost,batch,expiry,line in checked:
            lineid=c.execute('INSERT INTO purchase_lines(purchase_id,package_id,qty,received,bonus,cost,batch,expiry,amount) VALUES(?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?)',(new,pk['id'],qty,received,bonus,cost,batch,expiry,line)).lastrowid
            rec=(received+bonus)*pk['factor']
            if rec:
                # pilot simplified cost recognition: received item value allocated by billed qty ratio.
                value=(line*received//qty) if received else 0
                basecost=value*1000//rec if rec else 0
                # Unknown manufacturer batch must not merge separate physical receipts.
                # Original batch remains empty in purchase_lines; internal reference is NOT a manufacturer batch.
                inventory_batch=batch or f'UNRECORDED-PUR-{new}-{lineid}'
                old=one(c,'SELECT * FROM lots WHERE product_id=? AND batch=? AND expiry=? AND status=?',(pk['product_id'],inventory_batch,expiry,'sellable'))
                if old:
                    cumulative=old['qty_base']*old['unit_cost_milli']+rec*basecost
                    newcost=cumulative//(old['qty_base']+rec)
                    c.execute('UPDATE lots SET qty_base=qty_base+?,unit_cost_milli=? WHERE id=?',(rec,newcost,old['id']))
                    lotid=old['id']
                else:lotid=c.execute('INSERT INTO lots(product_id,batch,expiry,status,qty_base,unit_cost_milli) VALUES(?,?,?,?,?,?)',(pk['product_id'],inventory_batch,expiry,'sellable',rec,basecost)).lastrowid
                c.execute('INSERT INTO stock_moves(product_id,lot_id,qty_base,kind,document,created_at,user_id) VALUES(?,?,?,?,?,?,?)',(pk['product_id'],lotid,rec,'purchase',f'PUR-{new}',now(),uid))
                c.execute('INSERT INTO purchase_receipt_allocations(purchase_line_id,lot_id,received_base,created_at) VALUES(?,?,?,?)',(lineid,lotid,rec,now()))
                asset+=value
        # items invoiced but not yet received get clearing account until receiving workflow is completed.
        doc=f'PUR-{new}'
        journal(c,doc,[('INVENTORY',asset,0),('GOODS_IN_TRANSIT',total-asset,0),('AP',0,total)])
        if paid:
            journal(c,doc+'-PAY',[('AP',paid,0),('CASH' if method=='cash' else 'BANK_PENDING',0,paid)])
            c.execute('INSERT INTO payments(party_kind,party_id,doc,method,amount,bank_ref,created_at,user_id) VALUES(?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?)',('supplier',supplier,doc,method,paid,bankref,now(),uid))
        audit(c,uid,'purchase',{'id':new,'supplier':supplier,'invoice':ref,'total':total})
        finish(c)
    except:rollback(c);ra

### def purchase( 23683
def purchase(c,p,uid):
    supplier=posint(p.get('supplier_id'),'المورد')
    if not one(c,'SELECT id FROM suppliers WHERE id=?',(supplier,)):raise ValueError('المورد غير موجود')

        raise ValueError('لا يمكن إنشاء فاتورة بتاريخ فترة مقفلة')

        if received>qty:raise ValueError('المستلم لا يمكن أن يتجاوز كمية الفاتورة')

        if received+bonus and not re.fullmatch(r'\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}',expiry):raise ValueError('الصلاحية يجب أن تكون YYYY-MM-DD')
        if expiry:
            try:expiry_date=date.fromisoformat(expiry)
            except ValueError:raise ValueError('تاريخ الصلاحية غير صحيح')
            if received+bonus and expiry_date<=date.today():raise ValueError('الصلاحية اليوم أو منتهية؛ لا يمكن إضافة كمية متاحة للبيع')
        discount=amt(x.get('discount',0),'خصم السطر');line=qty*cost-discount
        if line<0:raise ValueError('خصم أكبر من قيمة السطر')
        checked.append((pk,qty,received,bonus,cost,batch,expiry,line))
    total=sum(x[-1] for x in checked);paid=amt(p.get('paid',0),'المدفوع');method=textv(p,'payment_method',24) or 'credit'

    if method=='credit' and paid:raise ValueError('اختر كاش أو تحويل للسداد الجزئي')
    bankref=textv(p,'bank_ref',90)
    if paid and method=='bank' and not bankref:raise ValueError('أدخل مرجع التحويل')
    begin(c)
    try:
        new=c.execute('INSERT INTO purchases(supplier_id,invoice_ref,invoice_date,created_at,user_id,total,paid,payment_method,bank_ref,note) VALUES(?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?)',(supplier,ref,dt,now(),uid,total,paid,method,bankref,textv(p,'note',500))).lastrowid
        asset=0
        for pk,qty,received,bonus,cost,batch,expiry,line in checked:
            lineid=c.execute('INSERT INTO purchase_lines(purchase_id,package_id,qty,received,bonus,cost,batch,expiry,amount) VALUES(?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?)',(new,pk['id'],qty,received,bonus,cost,batch,expiry,line)).lastrowid
            rec=(received+bonus)*pk['factor']
            if rec:
                # pilot simplified cost recognition: received item value allocated by billed qty ratio.
                value=(line*received//qty) if received else 0
                basecost=value*1000//rec if rec else 0
                # Unknown manufacturer batch must not merge separate physical receipts.
                # Original batch remains empty in purchase_lines; internal reference is NOT a manufacturer batch.
                inventory_batch=batch or f'UNRECORDED-PUR-{new}-{lineid}'
                old=one(c,'SELECT * FROM lots WHERE product_id=? AND batch=? AND expiry=? AND status=?',(pk['product_id'],inventory_batch,expiry,'sellable'))
                if old:
                    cumulative=old['qty_base']*old['unit_cost_milli']+rec*basecost
                    newcost=cumulative//(old['qty_base']+rec)
                    c.execute('UPDATE lots SET qty_base=qty_base+?,unit_cost_milli=? WHERE id=?',(rec,newcost,old['id']))
                    lotid=old['id']
                else:lotid=c.execute('INSERT INTO lots(product_id,batch,expiry,status,qty_base,unit_cost_milli) VALUES(?,?,?,?,?,?)',(pk['product_id'],inventory_batch,expiry,'sellable',rec,basecost)).lastrowid
                c.execute('INSERT INTO stock_moves(product_id,lot_id,qty_base,kind,document,created_at,user_id) VALUES(?,?,?,?,?,?,?)',(pk['product_id'],lotid,rec,'purchase',f'PUR-{new}',now(),uid))
                c.execute('INSERT INTO purchase_receipt_allocations(purchase_line_id,lot_id,received_base,created_at) VALUES(?,?,?,?)',(lineid,lotid,rec,now()))
                asset+=value
        # items invoiced but not yet received get clearing account until receiving workflow is completed.
        doc=f'PUR-{new}'
        journal(c,doc,[('INVENTORY',asset,0),('GOODS_IN_TRANSIT',total-asset,0),('AP',0,total)])
        if paid:
            journal(c,doc+'-PAY',[('AP',paid,0),('CASH' if method=='cash' else 'BANK_PENDING',0,paid)])
            c.execute('INSERT INTO payments(party_kind,party_id,doc,method,amount,bank_ref,created_at,user_id) VALUES(?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?)',('supplier',supplier,doc,method,paid,bankref,now(),uid))
        audit(c,uid,'purchase',{'id':new,'supplier':supplier,'invoice':ref,'total':total})
        finish(c)
    except:rollback(c);raise
    return {'id':new,'total':total,'paid':paid,'outstanding':total-paid}

def sell(c,p,uid):
    rows=p.get('items')
    if not isinstance(rows,list) or not rows:raise ValueError('أضف أصنافاً إلى فاتورة البيع')
    idemp=textv(p,'idempotency',90,True)
    partner_id=p.get('partner_id') or None;authority_id=p.get('authority_id') or None
    coverage=amt(p.get('coverage',0),'نسبة التغطية')
    if coverage>100:raise ValueError('نسبة التغطية يجب أن تكون بين 0 و100')
    if coverage and not authority_id:raise ValueError('اختر الجهة التي تتحمل الفاتورة')
    if authority_id:
        party=one(c,'SELECT * FROM partners WHERE id=? AND kind=?',(authority_id,'authority'))
        if not party:raise ValueError('الجهة غير موجودة')
    if partner_id and not one(c,'SELECT id FROM partners WHERE id=?',(partner_id,)):raise ValueError('المستفيد غير موجود')
    contract_id=p.get('insurance_contract_id') or None
    contract=None;membership=None
    if contract_id:
        contract=one(c,'SELECT * FROM insurance_contracts WHERE id=?',(posint(contract_id,'عقد التأمين'),))
        if not contract or not contract['active'] or contract['starts']>today() or (contract['ends'] and contract['ends']<today()):
            raise ValueError('عقد التأمين غير نشط أو خارج فترة الصلاحية')
        if int(authority_id or 0)!=contract['authority_id']:raise ValueError('جهة التغطية لا تطابق عقد التأمين')
        if partner_id:
            membership=one(c,'SELECT * FROM insurance_members WHERE contract_id=? AND partner_id=? AND active=1',(contract['id'],partner_id))
            if not membership:raise ValueError('المستفيد غير مرتبط بعقد التأمين')
    checked=[]
    rx_needed=False
    for x in rows:
        pkg=one(c,'SELECT pk.*,pr.name,pr.active,pr.rx_required FROM packages pk JOIN products pr ON pr.id=pk.product_id WHERE pk.id=?',(posint(x.get('package_id'),'العبوة'),))
        if not pkg or not pkg['active']:raise ValueError('الصنف غير موجود أو موقوف')
        if pkg['rx_required']:rx_needed=True
        qty=posint(x.get('qty'),'كمية البيع')
        checked.append((pkg,qty,qty*pkg['sale_price']))
    prescription=None
    if rx_needed:
        person=one(c,'SELECT permissions FROM users WHERE id=? AND active=1',(uid,))
        if not person or 'rx_verify' not in json.loads(person['permissions']):
            raise PermissionError('بيع الأدوية المقيدة بالوصفة يتطلب دخول صيدلي مخوّل بمراجعتها')
        record=p.get('prescription'

### def catalog( 17932
def catalog(c):
    prods=query(c,'SELECT * FROM products ORDER BY name')
    packs=query(c,'SELECT * FROM packages ORDER BY is_default DESC,id')
    lots=query(c,'SELECT id,product_id,batch,expiry,status,qty_base,unit_cost_milli FROM lots ORDER BY expiry')
    by_packs={};by_lots={}
    for pk in packs:by_packs.setdefault(pk['product_id'],[]).append(pk)
    for lot in lots:by_lots.setdefault(lot['product_id'],[]).append(lot)
    for p in prods:
        p['packages']=by_packs.get(p['id'],[])
        p['lots']=by_lots.get(p['id'],[])
        p['available']=sum(l['qty_base'] for l in p['lots'] if l['status']=='sellable' and (not l['expiry'] or l['expiry']>=today()))
    return prods

def create_product(c,p,uid):
    sku=textv(p,'sku',60,True);name=textv(p,'name',140,True)
    packages=p.get('packages',[])
    if not isinstance(packages,list) or not packages:raise ValueError('أدخل وحدة تعبئة واحدة على الأقل مع باركودها أو رمزها الداخلي')
    checked=[]
    for pk in packages:
        factor=posint(pk.get('factor'),'معامل التحويل')
        unit=textv(pk,'unit_name',40,True)
        barcode=textv(pk,'barcode',80)
        price=amt(pk.get('sale_price',0),'سعر البيع')
        checked.append((unit,factor,barcode or None,price,int(bool(pk.get('is_default',0)))))
    if sum(x[4] for x in checked)!=1:raise ValueError('يجب اختيار وحدة بيع افتراضية واحدة')
    begin(c)
    try:
        row=c.execute('INSERT INTO products(sku,name,generic_name,strength,form,manufacturer,base_uom,rx_required,reorder_point,created_at) VALUES(?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?)',(sku,name,textv(p,'generic_name'),textv(p,'strength'),textv(p,'form'),textv(p,'manufacturer'),textv(p,'base_uom',30) or 'حبة',int(bool(p.get('rx_required',0))),amt(p.get('reorder_point',0)),now()))
        pid=row.lastrowid
        for unit,factor,barcode,price,default in checked:c.execute('INSERT INTO packages(product_id,unit_name,factor,barcode,sale_price,is_default) VALUES(?,?,?,?,?,?)',(pid,unit,factor,barcode,price,default))
        audit(c,uid,'create_product',{'id':pid,'sku':sku})
        finish(c)
    except:rollback(c);raise
    return {'id':pid}

def update_product(c,p,uid):
    pid=posint(p.get('product_id'),'الصنف')
    begin(c)
    try:
        existing=one(c,'SELECT * FROM products WHERE id=?',(pid,))
        if not existing:raise ValueError('الصنف غير موجود')
        editable={'name':140,'generic_name':160,'strength':80,'form':80,'manufacturer':160}
        vals={k:textv(p,k,limit,required=k=='name') if k in p else existing[k] for k,limit in editable.items()}
        active=int(bool(p.get('active',existing['active'])))
        rx=int(bool(p.get('rx_required',existing['rx_required'])))
        reorder=amt(p.get('reorder_point',existing['reorder_point']),'حد إعادة الطلب')
        c.execute('UPDATE products SET name=?,generic_name=?,strength=?,form=?,manufacturer=?,active=?,rx_required=?,reorder_point=? WHERE id=?',(vals['name'],vals['generic_name'],vals['strength'],vals['form'],vals['manufacturer'],active,rx,reorder,pid))
        audit(c,uid,'edit_product',{'id':pid,'old':{k:existing[k] for k in ['name','active','rx_required','reorder_point']},'new':{'name':vals['name'],'active':active,'rx_required':rx,'reorder_point':reorder}})
        finish(c)
    except:rollback(c);raise
    return {'id':pid,'updated':True}

def edit_package(c,p,uid):
    id=posint(p.get('package_id'),'معرف العبوة');row=one(c,'SELECT * FROM packages WHERE id=?',(id,))
    if not row:raise ValueError('العبوة غير موجودة')
    barcode=textv(p,'barcode',80)
    price=amt(p.get('sale_price',row['sale_price']),'سعر البيع')
    begin(c)
    try:
        # Packaging factor cannot change after stock history; requires separate migration workflow
        c.execute('UPDATE packages SET barcode=?,sale_price=? WHERE id=?',(barcode or None,price,id))
        audit(c,uid,'update_package',{'id':id,'barcode_before':row['barcode'],'barcode_after':barcode,'old_price':row['sale_price'],'new_price':price})
        finish(c)
    except:rollback(c);raise
    return {'id':id}

def create_party(c,p,kind,uid):
    name=textv(p,'name',160,True)
    begin(c)
    try:
        cur=c.execute(('INSERT INTO suppliers(name,phone,notes) VALUES(?,?,?)' if kind=='supplier' else 'INSERT INTO partners(name,kind,phone,parent_id) VALUES(?,?,?,?)'),((name,textv(p,'phone',35),textv(p,'notes',300)) if kind=='supplier' else (name,kind,textv(p,'phone',35),p.get('parent_id'))))
        audit(c,uid,'create_'+kind,{'id':cur.lastrowid,'name':name})
        finish(c)
    except:rollback(c);raise
    return {'id':cur.lastrowid}

def available_lots(c,pid):
    return query(c,'SELECT * FROM lots WHERE product_id=? AND status=? AND qty_base>0 AND (expiry=? OR expiry>=?) ORDER BY CASE WHEN expiry=? THEN 1 ELSE 0 END,expiry,id',(pid,'sellable','',today(),''))

def allocate(c,pid,qty,slid,uid,doc):
    needed=qty;total_cost=0
    for lot in available_lots(c,pid):
        take=min(needed,lot['qty_base'])
        if take<=0:continue
        c.execute('UPDATE lots SET qty_base=qty_base-? WHERE id=? AND qty_base>=?',(take,lot['id'],take))
        if c.execute('SELECT changes()').fetchone()[0]!=1:raise ValueError('تعذر حسم الرصيد، حاول مرة أخرى')
        cost=(take*lot['unit_cost_milli']+500)//1000
        c.execute('INSERT INTO sale_allocations(sale_line_id,lot_id,qty_base,cost) VALUES(?,?,?,?)',(slid,lot['id'],take,cost))
        c.execute('INSERT INTO stock_moves(product_id,lot_id,qty_base,kind,document,created_at,user_id) VALUES(?,?,?,?,?,?,?)',(pid,lot['id'],-take,'sale',doc,now(),uid))
        total_cost+=cost;needed-=take
        if needed==0:break
    if needed:raise ValueError('الرصيد المتاح غير كافٍ: '+one(c,'SELECT name FROM products WHERE id=?',(pid,))['name'])
    return total_cost

def purchase(c,p,uid):
    supplier=posint(p.get('supplier_id'),'المورد')
    if not one(c,'SELECT id FROM suppliers WHERE id=?',(supplier,)):raise ValueError('المورد غير موجود')
    ref=textv(p,'invoice_ref',100) or ('LOCAL-'+datetime.now().strftime('%Y%m%d')+'-'+uuid.uuid4().hex[:12].upper()); dt=textv(p,'invoice_date',20) or today(); date.fromisoformat(dt)
    if one(c,'SELECT period FROM closed_periods WHERE period=?',(dt[:7],)):
        raise ValueError('لا يمكن إنشاء فاتورة بتاريخ فترة مقفلة')
    rows=p.get('items')
    if not isinstance(rows,list) or not rows:raise ValueError('أضف صنفاً واحداً على الأقل')
    checked=[]
    for x in rows:
        pk=one(c,'SELECT packages.*,products.name FROM packages JOIN products ON products.id=packages.product_id WHERE packages.id=?',(posint(x.get('package_id'),'العبوة'),))
        if not pk:raise ValueError('صنف الفاتورة غير موجود')
        qty=posint(x.get('qty'),'كمية الفاتورة');received=amt(x.get('received',qty),'المستلم');bonus=amt(x.get('bonus',0),'البونص')
        if received>qty:raise ValueError('المستلم لا يمكن أن يتجاوز كمية الفاتورة')
        cost=amt(x.get('unit_cost'),'سعر الشراء');batch=textv(x,'batch',70); expiry=textv(x,'expiry',10)
        if received+bonus and not re.fullmatch(r'\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}',expiry):raise ValueError('الصلاحية يجب أن تكون YYYY-MM-DD')
        if expiry:
            try:expiry_date=date.fromisoformat(expiry)
            except ValueError:raise ValueError('تاريخ الصلاحية غير صحيح')
            if received+bonus and expiry_date<=date.today():raise ValueError('الصلاحية اليوم أو منتهية؛ لا يمكن إضافة كمية متاحة للبيع')
        discount=amt(x.get('discount',0),'خصم السطر');line=qty*cost-discount
        if line<0:raise ValueError('خصم أكبر من قيمة السطر')
        checked.append((pk,qty,received,bonus,cost,batch,expiry,line))
    total=sum(x

### CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS packages 2286
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS packages(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, product_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES products(id), unit_name TEXT NOT NULL, factor INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(factor > 0), barcode TEXT UNIQUE, sale_price INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(sale_price>=0), is_default INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, UNIQUE(product_id,unit_name,factor));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS suppliers(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, phone TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', notes TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '');
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS partners(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT NOT NULL, kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(kind IN ('customer','authority','pharmacy')), phone TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', parent_id INTEGER REFERENCES partners(id), active INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS lots(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, product_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES products(id), batch TEXT NOT NULL, expiry TEXT NOT NULL, status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'sellable' CHECK(status IN ('sellable','quarantine')), qty_base INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(qty_base>=0), unit_cost_milli INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, UNIQUE(product_id,batch,expiry,status));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS purchases(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, supplier_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES suppliers(id), invoice_ref TEXT NOT NULL, invoice_date TEXT NOT NULL, created_at TEXT NOT NULL, user_id INTEGER REFERENCES users(id), total INTEGER NOT NULL, paid INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, payment_method TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'credit', bank_ref TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', note TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', UNIQUE(supplier_id,invoice_ref));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS purchase_lines(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,purchase_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES purchases(id), package_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES packages(id), qty INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(qty>0), received INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, bonus INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, cost INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(cost>=0), batch TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', expiry TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', amount INTEGER NOT NULL);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS sales(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, ref TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, idempotency TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, created_at TEXT NOT NULL, user_id INTEGER REFERENCES users(id), partner_id INTEGER REFERENCES partners(id), authority_id INTEGER REFERENCES partners(id), coverage INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(coverage BETWEEN 0 AND 100), total INTEGER NOT NULL, covered INTEGER NOT NULL, due INTEGER NOT NULL, cash_paid INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, bank_paid INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, bank_ref TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'completed');
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS sale_lines(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, sale_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES sales(id), package_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES packages(id), qty INTEGER NOT NULL, unit_price INTEGER NOT NULL, total INTEGER NOT NULL, cost INTEGER NOT NULL);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS sale_allocations(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, sale_line_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES sale_lines(id),lot_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES lots(id),qty_base INTEGER NOT NULL,cost INTEGER NOT NULL);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS purchase_returns(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,purchase_line_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES purchase_lines(id),qty INTEGER NOT NULL,amount INTEGER NOT NULL,created_at TEXT NOT NULL,reason TEXT NOT NULL,user_id INTEGER REFERENCES users(id));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS pharmacy_exchanges(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,partner_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES partners(id),out_package_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES packages(id),out_qty INTEGER NOT NULL,in_package_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES packages(id),in_qty INTEGER NOT NULL, in_batch TEXT NOT NULL,in_expiry TEXT NOT NULL,out_value INTEGER NOT NULL,in_value INTEGER NOT NULL,created_at TEXT NOT NULL,user_id INTEGER REFERENCES users(id));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS sale_returns(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,sale_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES sales(id),created_at TEXT NOT NULL,user_id INTEGER REFERENCES users(id),reason TEXT NOT NULL,refund_method TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'credit',amount INTEGER NOT NULL,covered INTEGER NOT NULL);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS return_lines(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,return_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES sale_returns(id),sale_line_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES sale_lines(id),qty INTEGER NOT NULL,amount INTEGER NOT NULL,covered INTEGER NOT NULL);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS stock_moves(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,product_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES products(id),lot_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES lots(id),qty_base INTEGER NOT NULL,kind TEXT NOT NULL,document TEXT NOT NULL, created_at TEXT NOT NULL,user_id INTEGER REFERENCES users(id));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS journals(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,doc TEXT NOT NULL,account TEXT NOT NULL,debit INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,credit INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,created_at TEXT NOT NULL, CHECK(debit>=0 AND credit>=0),CHECK((debit>0 AND credit=0) OR (credit>0 AND debit=0)));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS payments(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,party_kind TEXT NOT NULL,party_id INTEGER NOT NULL,doc TEXT NOT NULL,method TEXT NOT NULL,amount INTEGER NOT NULL,bank_ref TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',created_at TEXT NOT NULL,user_id INTEGER REFERENCES users(id));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS claims(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, authority_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES partners(id),period TEXT NOT NULL,created_at TEXT NOT NULL,status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'draft',total INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,paid INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,UNIQUE(authority_id,period));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS claim_sales(claim_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES claims(id),sale_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES sales(id),covered_amount INTEGER NOT NULL,PRIMARY KEY(claim_id,sale_id),UNIQUE(sale_id));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS audit(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,created_at TEXT NOT NULL,user_id INTEGER REFERENCES users(id),action TEXT NOT NULL, details TEXT NOT NULL);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS ix_packages_barcode ON packages(barcode);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS ix_lots_available ON lots(product_id,status,expiry,qty_base);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS ix_stock_product ON stock_moves(product_id);
"""

def now(): return datetime.now().isoformat(timespec='microseconds')
def today(): return date.today().isoformat()
def amt(x, field='المبلغ'):
    if isinstance(x,bool): raise ValueError('قيمة غير صحيحة: '+field)
    try: d=Decimal(str(x).strip())
    except (InvalidOperation,ValueError,AttributeError): raise ValueError('قيمة غير صحيحة: '+field)
    if not d.is_finite() or d != d.to_integral_value(): raise ValueError(field+' يجب أن يكون عدداً صحيحاً بالجنيه')
    n=int(d)
    if n < 0 or n>999999999999:raise ValueError('قيمة خارج النطاق: '+field)
    return n

def posint(x,name='الكمية'):
    n=amt(x,name)
    if n<=0: raise ValueError(name+' يجب أن تكون موجبة')
    return n

def textv(d,k,limit=200,required=False):
    s=str(d.get(k,'') or '').strip()
    if len(s)>limit or (required and not s):raise ValueError('حقل غير صالح: '+k)
    return s

def db_connect():
    DATA.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
    con=sqlite3.connect(DB,timeout=20,isolation_level=None,check_same_thread=False)
    con.row_factory=sqlite3.Row
    con.execute('PRAGMA foreign_keys=ON')
    con.execute('PRAGMA busy_timeout=20000')
    con.execute('PRAGMA journal_mode=WAL')
    con.execute('PRAGMA synchronous=FULL')
    return con
